title: Pure Volcanic
summary: Volcanic monsters with their Blaze Accelerator Spells and generic Pyro Xyz Monsters and staples. The 2023 cards lead. Volcanic Trooper searches any Volcanic card and gives the opponent Bomb Tokens that burn when destroyed. Volcanic Rimfire mills a Volcanic or swaps one Blaze Accelerator Spell for another. Volcanic Blaze Accelerator summons a Volcanic from the hand each turn and destroys a monster by milling a Level 1 Pyro. Volcanic Emperor summons itself by banishing three Pyro or a Blaze Accelerator card, burns for each one, and Sets a Volcanic Trap. It then burns 500 every time they Special Summon. Volcanic Scattershot burns when it hits the GY, and three of them wipe their monsters. Volcanic Emission fetches a Volcanic or burns for a Pyro's ATK, and Volcanic Inferno negates monster effects.
